add-png-logo-to-first-page.title: Add PNG Logo to First Page of PDF
add-png-logo-to-first-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, place a PNG logo at specific coordinates on the first page, and save the modified document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Background Image to PDF Pages with Opacity
add-background-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent background image on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and save the result.

add-transparent-png-overlay-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Transparent PNG Overlay to PDF Pages
add-transparent-png-overlay-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through each page, and place a full‑page transparent PNG overlay above existing content before saving the document.

add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Diagonal Image Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp with a 45° rotation and semi‑transparent opacity, apply it to each page as a background watermark, and save the modified document.

add-centered-logo-to-first-pdf-page.title: Add Centered Logo to First PDF Page
add-centered-logo-to-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp for a logo, center it on the first page, and save the modified document.

add-header-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Image to Each PDF Page
add-header-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a decorative header image at the top of every page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, calculating a rectangle so the image does not overlap existing content.

add-decorative-footer-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Decorative Footer Image to PDF Pages
add-decorative-footer-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert a footer image on every page of a PDF, scaling it proportionally to the page width using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-pattern-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Background Pattern Image to PDF Pages
add-background-pattern-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent background pattern image on each page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-subtle-background-pattern-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Subtle Background Pattern to PDF Pages
add-subtle-background-pattern-to-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to apply a low‑opacity pattern image as a background artifact on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image to PDF Pages
add-background-image-to-pdf.description: Shows how to place a background image on each page of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf, configuring it as a background artifact with adjustable opacity for a subtle shading effect.

add-texture-background-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Texture Background Image to PDF Pages
add-texture-background-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to place a subtle texture image as a background on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's BackgroundArtifact and adjust its opacity.

add-semi-transparent-overlay-image-to-pd.title: Add Semi-Transparent Overlay Image to PDF
add-semi-transparent-overlay-image-to-pd.description: Demonstrates how to apply a semi‑transparent PNG overlay to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, stretching the image to cover each page.

add-semi-transparent-overlay-to-pdf-page.title: Add Semi-Transparent Overlay to PDF Pages from Theme Config
add-semi-transparent-overlay-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to read a JSON theme file, parse a hex color with opacity, and draw a full‑page semi‑transparent rectangle overlay on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-semi-transparent-image-watermark-to-.title: Add Semi-Transparent Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-image-watermark-to-.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi-transparent PNG watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with opacity configurable via a setting.

replace-jpeg-with-png-on-pdf-page.title: Replace JPEG with High‑Resolution PNG on PDF Page
replace-jpeg-with-png-on-pdf-page.description: Shows how to replace an existing JPEG image on the third page of a PDF with a higher‑resolution PNG using Aspose.Pdf's Resources.Images collection.

replace-jpeg-with-png-in-pdf.title: Replace JPEG Images with PNG in PDF
replace-jpeg-with-png-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page and image resource, and replace every JPEG image with a PNG file while preserving the original layout.

vectorize-pdf-replace-raster-with-svg.title: Vectorize PDF Pages by Replacing Raster Images with SVG
vectorize-pdf-replace-raster-with-svg.description: Shows how to extract vector graphics from each PDF page as SVG, substitute raster pages with the SVG version when possible, and rebuild the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-images-on-odd-pages-with-placeho.title: Replace Images on Odd PDF Pages with Placeholder
replace-images-on-odd-pages-with-placeho.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF, locate image placements on odd‑numbered pages, and replace each image with a placeholder graphic while keeping the original dimensions and positioning.

replace-images-odd-pages-qr-placeholder.title: Replace Images on Odd Pages with QR Code Placeholder
replace-images-odd-pages-qr-placeholder.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through odd‑numbered PDF pages, locate each image, and replace it with a QR‑code placeholder while preserving a reference to the original image.

convert-even-pdf-pages-to-grayscale.title: Convert Even PDF Pages to Grayscale
convert-even-pdf-pages-to-grayscale.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, apply a grayscale conversion only to even-numbered pages, and save the modified document.

replace-images-last-page-with-banner.title: Replace Images on Last PDF Page with Full-Width Banner
replace-images-last-page-with-banner.description: Demonstrates how to hide all existing images on the final page of a PDF and insert a banner image that spans the page width using Aspose.Pdf.

compress-pdf-images-using-optimization.title: Compress Images in PDF Using Aspose.Pdf Optimization
compress-pdf-images-using-optimization.description: The example loads a PDF, configures image compression options (quality and resolution), applies resource optimization to compress large images, and saves the reduced‑size PDF.

replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder.title: Replace PDF Images with Placeholder and Add Hyperlink
replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder.description: Shows how to replace each image in a PDF with a small placeholder PNG and overlay a link annotation that points to the original image location.

convert-pdf-images-to-monochrome.title: Convert PDF Images to Monochrome
convert-pdf-images-to-monochrome.description: Shows how to open a PDF, iterate through each page's images, and replace them with a black‑and‑white version using Aspose.Pdf.

correct-pdf-image-orientation.title: Correct PDF Image Orientation Using EXIF Data
correct-pdf-image-orientation.description: Loads a PDF, reads each embedded image's EXIF orientation, rotates or flips the image accordingly, and replaces it in the PDF to ensure proper display.

compress-large-images-in-pdf.title: Compress Large Images in PDF
compress-large-images-in-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, configure image compression to replace images larger than 2 MB with compressed JPEGs, and save the optimized document.

replace-pdf-images-with-qr-placeholder.title: Replace PDF Images with QR Code Placeholder
replace-pdf-images-with-qr-placeholder.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF, replace each embedded image with a QR‑code placeholder image, and store the original image name as alternative text using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-images-on-pdf-page.title: Replace Images on a PDF Page Using a Dictionary
replace-images-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to replace specific images on a given PDF page by mapping image indices to new image files using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-images-with-icc-profile-jpeg.title: Replace PDF Images with ICC‑Profile JPEGs
replace-pdf-images-with-icc-profile-jpeg.description: Shows how to iterate through each page of a PDF and replace all embedded images with a JPEG that contains an embedded ICC color profile using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-images-with-logo.title: Replace Images on PDF Page with New Logo
replace-images-with-logo.description: Creates a sample PDF containing an image, then uses ImagePlacementAbsorber to locate all image placements and replaces each with a new in‑memory logo image.

replace-title-page-banner.title: Replace Title Page Images with High‑Resolution Banner
replace-title-page-banner.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate the title page, and replace all existing images on that page with a high‑resolution banner image while preserving the original text layout.

replace-index-page-images-with-banner.title: Replace Index Page Images with a Banner Image
replace-index-page-images-with-banner.description: Shows how to replace every image on the first (index) page of a PDF with a single banner image using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder__v2.title: Replace All PDF Images with a Placeholder
replace-pdf-images-with-placeholder__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, replace every embedded image with a low‑resolution placeholder image, and save the modified document.

remove-all-images-from-pdf.title: Remove All Images from PDF Pages
remove-all-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, delete all images from the page resources, and save the cleaned document.

remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf.title: Remove Low-Resolution Images from PDF
remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to scan each page of a PDF, use ImagePlacementAbsorber to find images, hide those with DPI lower than 72, optimize resources, and save the result.

remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf__v.title: Remove Low-Resolution Images from PDF
remove-low-resolution-images-from-pdf__v.description: Shows how to delete images with a DPI lower than 72 using ImagePlacementAbsorber, hide the low‑resolution images, optimize resources, and save the updated PDF.

remove-duplicate-images-from-pdf.title: Remove Duplicate Images from PDF
remove-duplicate-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDF pages, compute a hash of each image's raw bytes, and delete duplicate images using Aspose.Pdf APIs, then re‑optimize the document.

collect-image-resolution-metadata.title: Collect Image Resolution Metadata from PDF Pages
collect-image-resolution-metadata.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, finds all images using ImagePlacementAbsorber, and reports their DPI resolution and visible size.

resize-images-half-size.title: Resize Images on PDF Pages to Half Size
resize-images-half-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page and its paragraphs, detect Image objects, scale them to 50 % of their original dimensions, and save the modified document.

resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale-fac.title: Resize Images in PDF Using Configurable Scale Factor
resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale-fac.description: The example reads a scaling factor from a configuration file and applies it to all images in a PDF, resizing them before saving the document.

resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale.title: Resize Images in PDF Using Configurable Scale Factor
resize-pdf-images-using-config-scale.description: Demonstrates loading a scaling factor from appsettings.json and applying it to all image objects in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then saving the modified document.

resize-images-on-pdf-pages.title: Resize Images on PDF Pages Using a Config File
resize-images-on-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to read a JSON configuration that defines target dimensions per page, extract each image with ImagePlacementAbsorber, hide the original, and re‑add it with the new size in an Aspose.Pdf document.

add-raster-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Raster Image to PDF Page
add-raster-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to insert a raster image (PNG, JPEG, etc.) onto a newly created PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's Image class and the Paragraphs collection.

insert-raster-image-into-pdf-page.title: Insert Raster Image into PDF Page
insert-raster-image-into-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, define an absolute rectangle, and insert a raster image onto a specific page using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-embedded-raster-image.title: Resize Embedded Raster Image in PDF
resize-embedded-raster-image.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, define a rectangle with new dimensions, and replace an embedded raster image by adding it with the specified width and height before saving the document.

replace-image-on-pdf-page.title: Replace Image on PDF Page
replace-image-on-pdf-page.description: Shows how to locate image placements on a specific PDF page and replace each with a new image loaded from a file stream using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-raster-image-from-pdf-page.title: Delete Raster Image from PDF Page
delete-raster-image-from-pdf-page.description: Shows how to remove a specific raster image from a PDF page by deleting its reference in the page resources using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-raster-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Raster Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-raster-images-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through each page's image resources, and saves every raster image as an individual PNG file.

extract-images-from-pdf-preserve-format.title: Extract Images from PDF Preserving Original Format
extract-images-from-pdf-preserve-format.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf, extract each embedded raster image, detect its original format from header bytes, and save the image to disk without conversion.

extract-images-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Extract Images from Multiple PDFs
extract-images-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files in a folder and extract every embedded image, saving them as PNG files with unique names.

add-dicom-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add DICOM Image to PDF Page using FileStream
add-dicom-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, read a DICOM image via a FileStream, and place the image on a page at a defined rectangle using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-dicom-image-with-custom-size.title: Insert DICOM Image with Custom Size into PDF
insert-dicom-image-with-custom-size.description: Shows how to add a DICOM image to a PDF document and control its resolution by setting explicit Width and Height on an ImageStamp before stamping.

render-pdf-page-to-png-with-fallback-fon.title: Render PDF Page to PNG with Fallback Font
render-pdf-page-to-png-with-fallback-fon.description: Demonstrates how to render the first page of a PDF to a PNG image while specifying a default fallback font using Aspose.Pdf rendering options.

render-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-with-default-fo.title: Render PDF Pages to JPEG with Default Font
render-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-with-default-fo.description: Demonstrates how to convert each page of a PDF document to a JPEG image while specifying a default font for missing glyphs using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.title: Generate PNG Thumbnails for PDF Pages
generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.description: Creates 150x200 pixel PNG thumbnail images for each page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's ThumbnailDevice.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG with Default Font
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.description: Shows how to load a PDF, set RenderingOptions.DefaultFontName to Arial, and convert each page to a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

render-pdf-to-tiff-with-lzw-and-font-fal.title: Render PDF to Multi-Page TIFF with LZW Compression and Font Fallback
render-pdf-to-tiff-with-lzw-and-font-fal.description: The example loads a PDF, applies a default font fallback for missing characters, and renders all pages to a single multi-page TIFF file using LZW compression at 300 DPI.

export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-300-dpi.title: Export PDF Pages to BMP Images at 300 DPI
export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-300-dpi.description: Shows how to convert each page of a PDF into a 300‑DPI BMP image using Aspose.Pdf's BmpDevice with a custom resolution.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-default-f.title: Convert PDF to Multi-Page TIFF with Default Font
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff-default-f.description: Demonstrates converting an entire PDF document into a multi‑page TIFF file using Aspose.Pdf, setting resolution, TIFF options, and applying a default font for rendering missing fonts.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Extract Vector Graphics from PDF Page to SVG
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Demonstrates using GraphicsAbsorber to collect vector graphics from a specific PDF page and converting them to an SVG file for further manipulation.

move-vector-graphic-position.title: Move Vector Graphic to New Position Using Matrix
move-vector-graphic-position.description: Demonstrates how to shift a vector graphic on a PDF page by updating its Position or applying a translation matrix with Aspose.Pdf.

transfer-vector-graphic-between-pdf-page.title: Transfer Vector Graphic Between PDF Pages
transfer-vector-graphic-between-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates extracting vector graphics from a source PDF page with GraphicsAbsorber, repositioning them, and adding them to another PDF page.

remove-vector-graphic-from-pdf-page.title: Remove Vector Graphic from PDF Page
remove-vector-graphic-from-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to locate vector graphics on a PDF page using GraphicsAbsorber and delete a selected graphic, then save the modified document.

copy-vector-graphics-between-pdf-pages.title: Copy Vector Graphics Between PDF Pages
copy-vector-graphics-between-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract vector graphic objects from a source PDF page using GraphicsAbsorber and insert each graphic individually onto a target PDF page.

add-vector-graphics-to-pdf-page.title: Add Vector Graphics to a PDF Page
add-vector-graphics-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to create a new PDF page, build a Graph with rectangle, ellipse, and line shapes, and add the vector graphics to the document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-extract-vector-graphics-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Vector Graphics from PDFs
batch-extract-vector-graphics-from-pdfs.description: Loads all PDF files from a specified input folder, iterates through each page, and extracts any vector graphics as SVG files, storing them in separate subfolders per document and page.

add-alternative-text-to-pdf-images.title: Add Alternative Text to PDF Images
add-alternative-text-to-pdf-images.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages and images, set alternative text for each image to improve accessibility, and save the updated document.

retrieve-image-alt-text.title: Retrieve Alternative Text from PDF Images
retrieve-image-alt-text.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page and its image resources, extracts any alternative (alt) text associated with the images, and logs the results for auditing.

add-image-with-alt-text-to-pdf.title: Add Image with Alternative Text to PDF
add-image-with-alt-text-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert an image into an existing PDF document and assign alternative (alt) text for accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.

render-pdf-to-png-300-dpi-default-font.title: Render PDF Pages to PNG at 300 DPI with Default Font
render-pdf-to-png-300-dpi-default-font.description: The example loads a PDF, configures a font substitution to use Arial for missing fonts, and renders each page to a PNG image at 300 DPI.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG with Default Font Override
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-with-default-fo.description: Demonstrates how to set RenderingOptions.DefaultFontName to "Times New Roman" and convert each page of a PDF document to PNG images using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-vector-graphic-with-raster-image.title: Replace Vector Graphic with Raster Image in PDF
replace-vector-graphic-with-raster-image.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, detecting pages with vector graphics, and overlaying a raster PNG in the same location while preserving layout, then flattening transparency and saving the result.
